regional.common: severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus (SFTSV)
regional.syndrome: Fever, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia, gastrointestinal symptoms and elevated liver enzymes, progressing in severe cases to haemorrhage, encephalopathy and multi-organ failure. Older age and high viral load predict death.
regional.headline: Tick-borne bandavirus causing a severe haemorrhagic febrile illness in East Asia, with case fatality of roughly 5–30%.
regional.prevention: Tick avoidance, protective measures in animal handling, strict infection control for contact with patients' blood and secretions.
regional.geography: China, South Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Taiwan.
regional.evidence_note: Human infection has been confirmed in this country.

regional.syndrome: Fewer than 1% of infections become clinical, but encephalitis carries ~20–30% mortality and leaves neurological or psychiatric sequelae in a third to a half of survivors; parkinsonian and acute flaccid paralysis presentations are characteristic.
regional.headline: The leading cause of vaccine-preventable viral encephalitis in Asia.
regional.prevention: Highly effective inactivated and live-attenuated vaccines (e.g. IXIARO, SA 14-14-2) in routine childhood programmes; pig husbandry siting; vector control.
regional.geography: South, Southeast and East Asia, Papua New Guinea, northern Australia.
regional.evidence_note: Human infection has been confirmed in this country.

regional.syndrome: Five classical phases — febrile, hypotensive, oliguric, diuretic and convalescent — with haemorrhage, acute kidney injury and shock; case fatality 5–15%.
regional.headline: Prototype hantavirus and cause of the severe form of haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) in East Asia.
regional.prevention: Rodent control, dust-avoidance precautions; inactivated vaccines (Hantavax) used in Korea and China.
regional.evidence_note: Human infection has been confirmed in this country.

regional.headline: MERS-CoV. Severe respiratory disease acquired from dromedary camels.
regional.geography: MERS-CoV. Severe respiratory disease acquired from dromedary camels.
regional.evidence_note: Human infection has been confirmed in this country.

regional.headline: Hepatitis D virus genotype 2. East Asia; generally milder course than genotype 1.
regional.geography: Hepatitis D virus genotype 2. East Asia; generally milder course than genotype 1.
regional.evidence_note: Human infection has been confirmed in this country.

regional.headline: Rotavirus H. Detected in human stool in Asia; also porcine. Clinical role unresolved.
regional.geography: Rotavirus H. Detected in human stool in Asia; also porcine. Clinical role unresolved.
regional.evidence_note: Human infection has been confirmed in this country.

regional.headline: Tick-borne encephalitis virus, Far Eastern and Siberian subtypes. Severe meningoencephalitis; vaccine-preventable.
regional.geography: Tick-borne encephalitis virus, Far Eastern and Siberian subtypes. Severe meningoencephalitis; vaccine-preventable.
regional.evidence_note: Virus, viral RNA or specific antibody found in the reservoir host or in livestock, with no human case reported. The virus is present in the country; whether it has ever infected a person there is unknown.
